note: Plan 0026, R10, D8: the people of the showcase of Bãi Trước (scenes/world/showcase_people.gd). The walkers go back and forth along the footways of the park and the ways of the walk of the sea, keep_right_m to the right of the middle of the way (less on a narrow way), and stop when the player stands in front of them; the sitters sit on the borders of the raised lawns, with their backs to the lawn. hours gives the part of the people that is there at each hour: [hour, part]. At 17:00 all of them are there (about 40, R10); at noon fewer. The culture notes (Confirmed): in the evening many families come to Bãi Trước, swim, and sit on the paved edge of the park. The counts and the parts are builder values. spots: some of the walkers walk on a short way in the frame of a shot (report 0026, D-0026-07: at 17:00 people walk on the walk of the sea and in the park, near the places of the shots and of the player); the others go on the ways of the park.

spots.name: the walk at the top of the beach (S1)
the lawn of the leaning palms (S2)
the walk of the sea by the raised lawns at sunset (S5)

walkers.models_note: non_rong_vanh: the woman in the wide sun hat of report 0026, Q19 (data/world/drawings/non_rong_vanh.json).

swimmers.note: Report 0026, D-0026-20 and Q20: the swimmers of Bãi Trước in T-shirts and shorts (the person blueprint of World: swimmer_1 to swimmer_4, and walker_5, a boy in a T-shirt and quần đùi), some with a swim ring phao_boi at the water line: a child stands in its ring, an adult holds the ring at its side. Each swimmer has a point on the line, which is on the sand at the top of the beach in front of the shot S1 (the ground of the game is 1.5 m there), and goes out along to_sea (at right angles to the water's edge from z -200 to z -60) to the point where the water at its feet is its depth (depth_m, child_depth_m for a person younger than child_age), at each sea level of the tide. hours: the part of the swimmers in the sea at each hour (the culture notes: people swim at Bãi Trước early in the morning and in the evening; no photo gives the counts). The count, the depths, the part with a ring, and the hours are builder values.
